game_title: Divide Or Floor – Charred Forest Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split ash bricks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split ash bricks evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the share value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about share to power up the ash ranger and open the smelter.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
